load_order.purpose: Kit map: where every activation file lives, so later phases resolve paths against the map, not memory.
Agent boot contract: Prime Judgment Law, human authority, truth/proof ladder, decision efficiency doctrine.
Base Naya role contract: what a Naya is, independent of seat specialization.
The seat's own role contract (ENGINEERING-NAYA, DESIGN-NAYA, RESEARCH-NAYA, QA-NAYA, PRODUCT-NAYA, ARCHITECTURE-NAYA, CODA, FUTURE-AGENTS). Fail-closed: no boot on a guessed role.
Identity/mission/history content: who Shawn is, NayaPOWER, NayaNET, the Hub, current engineering reality, the 24-question cold reconstruction test.
Ratified strategic context (newest first): the current mission objective the seat will serve.
Source-of-truth precedence: live repo + issues/PRs outrank stale brief text. Resolve newest file matching the glob.

load_order.path: <LIVE: main tip + open issues/PRs in assignment area>
load_order.purpose: Live state at boot time: current tip, open issues/PRs, recent commits relevant to the assignment. Noted-and-skipped only if the repo is unreachable; then Phase 1 records UNKNOWN for live state.
MANDATORY: The Operating Law — all 8 domains (Decision, Communication, Execution, Learning, Authority, Constitution, Design, Code). The lock. No fallback, no summary-of-summary.
MANDATORY: Machine twin of the Operating Law — queryable form of the same law the seat reads in prose.
Standing nonstop-loop operating law (prose form). Required while it stands as ratified law.
Machine twin of the nonstop-loop operating law.
Lane doctrine: canonical design contract. required=true when the assignment touches design; otherwise skipped.
Lane doctrine: design intelligence standard (the design operating method). required=true when the assignment touches design.
Lane doctrine: engineering truth law (status ladder, evidence rules). required=true when the assignment touches code/engineering.
Lane doctrine: Smart Note capture protocol. required=true when the assignment touches learning/capture.
Decision math (value calculus spec). required=true when the assignment involves a consequential choice; kernel/value_calculus.py is the executable twin.
The assignment itself: exact task, expected outcome, constraints, success criteria (Allocation Law job definition). Missing any of the four = bounced to dispatcher, no work starts.

Load verification: seven answers from working memory (seat, Shawn, supreme principle, three Prime laws, five protected gates, lane proof bar, assignment outcome + success criteria). Then Layer 2 ritual.

notes: Ordered load list for Layer 1 boot. entry_kind: 'file' = resolve path at ref; 'substituted' = dispatcher replaces <THIS-SEAT> with the seat's role contract before issuing the brief; 'live' = resolve against live repo state at boot time; 'dispatch' = the assignment handoff, not a file; 'none' = verification phase, no new load. The dispatcher resolves every entry against the live repo before issuing the boot brief. required=true entries are fail-closed: if one cannot be resolved, boot stops and the seat reports BLOCKED with the exact missing path. required=false entries are noted-and-skipped.
